style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 1.5m Dual Colour Micro LED Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Add a magical sparkle to your Christmas display with this dual colour LED garland. </p><p>This gorgeous piece runs to 1.5m in length and features 180 LED micro lights which can be set to glow in either a golden warm white, a cool silver shade or a combination of the two as desired.<br><br>Drape this verdant garland along a mantlepiece below your Christmas cards, or swag along the banisters and add velvet ribbon bows at regular intervals along the foliage for a luxurious decorative effect.<br><br>To illuminate, simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the attached battery box. </p><p>Use the switch on the box to select your preferred colourway and to set the handy 6 hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening. Size : ONE</p>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Add a magical sparkle to your Christmas display with this dual colour LED garland. This gorgeous piece runs to 1.5m in length and features 180 LED micro lights which can be set to glow in either a golden warm white, a cool silver shade or a combination of the two as desired. Drape this verdant garland along a mantlepiece below your Christmas cards, or swag along the banisters and add velvet ribbon bows at regular intervals along the foliage for a luxurious decorative effect. To illuminate, simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the attached battery box. Use the switch on the box to select your preferred colourway and to set the handy 6-hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening. Size: ONE.
